messages:
carla_support: Heads-up — BayFront pilot can't complete onboarding: SSO setup fails with ACS redirect loop. Reported 07:12 UTC; pilot kickoff next morning. Marking P0 for renewal risk.

carla_support: error snippet from sso-worker:
```text
[2026-03-23T07:10:54Z] SSO_FAIL org=bayfront-pilot-3 step=acs_redirect err=REDIRECT_LOOP
```

sys_bot: Alert created: ALERT-6092; routed to eng-runtime.

mike_cs: I'll own comms. Need POC emails and whether this began after the IdP metadata update. Also flagging renewal touch — customer has trial exec call Friday. @jordan_prod any recent SSO changes?

carla_support: Reporter: alice@bayfront.io (IT lead). Affected org: bayfront-pilot-3. We show IdP metadata change at 06:55 UTC from customer side and our SAML parser failing to consume an unescaped ampersand in the EntityDescriptor. Added ticket ST-10022 with raw metadata.

jordan_prod: Confirmed parser error: strict XML parser choked on attribute with unescaped '&'. Quick mitigation: accept lenient parse for this request or allow customer to re-upload fixed metadata. Command to toggle lenient SAML parsing per-org:
```bash
redwood-admin org-config set --org bayfront-pilot-3 --key saml_lenient_parse --value true
```
I can apply lenient parse now to unblock. Long-term we should improve metadata validation UI and surface a friendly error.

anya_am: Please apply lenient parse now. We need the demo to succeed and preserve renewal momentum. I'll prepare comms: apology + workaround + invite to quick validation call.

jordan_prod: Applied `saml_lenient_parse=true` for bayfront-pilot-3. Re-tested SSO: user can complete login and land on dashboard. Response: 200 OK.

mike_cs: Draft comms (short): 1) apology + cause (metadata formatting issue) 2) confirm we've applied a temporary compatibility fix and invites/login should work 3) propose 20-min validation call before the exec demo 4) next steps: ask customer to re-upload corrected metadata and we'll remove workaround. Sending to @anya_am for AM tone.

carla_support: Logged change request CR-9123 authorizing per-org lenient parsing override. Also added renewal flag in SFDC for primary contact.

anya_am: Sent customer note and set up 08:30 PT validation call. I've drafted a renewal-friendly line: "we applied a temporary compatibility fix to ensure your demo runs as planned; we'll coordinate a permanent metadata update afterwards."

mike_cs: Recap owners: (1) CS sends comms + runs validation call (mike_cs) (2) AM handles renewal framing + follow-up (anya_am) (3) Eng to harden metadata validation + remove lenient flag after customer updates (jordan_prod) (4) Support to monitor SSO logs and close ST-10022 when metadata updated (carla_support).

sys_bot: ALERT-6092 status -> mitigated; note added by jordan_prod.
